Name: DialogueLogMod
Author: xingminglehuan
Description:
[heading]Features[/heading]
[list]
[*]Records dialogue shown in NPC dialogue boxes.[/*]
[*]Shows the in-game time and speaker name.[/*]
[*]Automatically wraps long lines to fit the log panel.[/*]
[*]Scroll through the log with the mouse wheel.[/*]
[*]Skips system prompts and dialogue without a named speaker.[/*]
[/list][heading]Controls[/heading]
[list]
[*]Press the [b]'[/b] key to open or close the log.[/*]
[*]Use the mouse wheel to scroll through previous dialogue.[/*]
[/list]On a US keyboard, this is the key that types an apostrophe or quotation mark.
[heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or later[/*]
[/list][heading]Installation[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Extract the archive.[/*]
[*]Place the
[code]DialogueLogMod[/code]folder in your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][line]
中文说明
在游戏中查看最近的 NPC 对话记录。日志最多保留 100 条对话。
[heading]功能[/heading]
[list]
[*]记录 NPC 对话框中显示的对话。[/*]
[*]显示游戏时间和说话人名称。[/*]
[*]长文本会自动换行，以适应日志面板。[/*]
[*]使用鼠标滚轮翻阅对话记录。[/*]
[*]不记录系统提示或没有说话人名称的内容。[/*]
[/list][heading]按键[/heading]
[list]
[*]按键盘上的 ' 键打开或关闭日志。[/*]
[*]使用鼠标滚轮翻阅记录。[/*]
[/list]美式键盘上，这是输入单引号或双引号的按键。
[heading]安装[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]解压压缩包。[/*]
[*]将
[code]DialogueLogMod[/code]文件夹放入《星露谷物语》的
[code]Mods[/code]文件夹。[/*]
[*]通过 SMAPI 启动游戏。[/*]
[/list]
